name: Governance, risk and compliance (GRC)
short_description: GRC is the combined discipline of governance, risk management and regulatory compliance; in Microsoft 365 it covers ownership, data protection, audit readiness and related controls.

evidence.quote: Most organizations believe that Microsoft 365 GRC maturity is built on more policies, more controls
Let's talk about governance, risk and compliance reports GRC, the three letters responsible for more caffeine
